jsonld.description: Trendy style blends with a premier location at Aloft Columbus Westerville. Located just 10 miles from John Glenn Columbus International Airport, our hotel offers easy access to local favorites. Catch a hockey game at Nationwide Center, shop until you drop at Easton Town Center or check out central Ohio's Hoover Dam. Back at our hotel, grab a drink from our W XYZ® bar while catching up with friends or networking with coworkers. Get active in our 24-hour fitness center with free weights and cardio equipment, and then cool off with a few laps in our indoor pool. Looking for somewhere to host a meeting? Our stylish spaces offer access to event planners and AV equipment. After a long day, settle into your room and enjoy our contemporary amenities, including free Wi-Fi, premium movie channels and mini-refrigerators. With our suite options and pet-friendly policy, it's easy to customize your stay to fit your needs. Wake up refreshed and renewed for a great day at Aloft Columbus Westerville.
